name: grv-claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods in the style of oh-my-pi: tool cards, question frames, a session sidebar, an agents sidebar and a context bar

plugins.name: fold-tools
plugins.description: oh-my-pi style click-to-fold cards for tool calls and code changes, with a one-line intent heading

plugins.name: turn-questions
plugins.description: Frames every question Claude asked in a turn: AskUserQuestion calls and questions in its replies

plugins.name: session-sidebar
plugins.description: A docked sidebar of this session's subagents, todos and changed files

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: oh-my-pi style bar under the prompt: model, effort, a context-usage gauge, rate limits, and agents and compact buttons

plugins.name: agent-sidebar
plugins.description: A docked Agents tab listing every background agent by state, like Claude Code's agent view
